lexicon.name: Canal measurement
lexicon.description: A researcher selects a tooth, derives its canal geometry, and reads a measurement alongside a spatial view. This model explains the selected-tooth workflow in DentalML, especially why the displayed path can differ from the measured path.

context.name: Tooth selection
context.description: Choose a tooth by its FDI label and isolate the matching tooth and pulp masks.

concept.name: Selected tooth
concept.description: The FDI-labelled tooth chosen from the loaded volumes. The same label selects its tooth mask and pulp mask.
concept.code-link: Parses the FDI selection and isolates both masks.

concept.name: Tooth input
concept.description: Selected masks, volume metadata, and full-arch data supplied to the measurement workflow.
concept.code-link: Receives the selected tooth data and calculation parameters.

context.name: Canal measurement
context.description: Derive local geometry and physical measurements for each extracted canal.

concept.name: Canal measurement
concept.description: One canal’s geometry, reference points, and derived values, considered together as a consistency boundary. The current Canal class is a mutable result container.
concept.annotation: Geometry, reference point, spacing, and measurements should describe the same calculation. Changing the geometry requires recalculating dependent values.
The aggregate is a proposed domain interpretation. Callers currently coordinate mutation; the class permits direct field assignment.
concept.code-link: Gathers endpoints, path, region, and result fields.
Populates the result through extraction and calculation.

concept.name: Canal index
concept.description: An enumeration identifying a canal within one extraction result. The implementation stores it in Canal.tooth_id. It has a different meaning from the selected tooth’s FDI label.
concept.annotation: extract_canal_and_centerline assigns the enumerated apice_id to tooth_id. A new extraction may produce a different enumeration.
concept.code-link: Assigns the local canal index when constructing each Canal.

concept.name: Measurement path
concept.description: The ordered local voxel points used to calculate length and angle. Its starting reference depends on the calculation branch.
concept.annotation: The single-canal branch prepends a crown reference to the measurement path itself. This branch is selected by multi_canal_flag; posterior handling is selected separately.
concept.code-link: Builds a path using the selected extraction method.
May extend the calculation path with a crown reference.

concept.name: Reference point
concept.description: The point that establishes the starting reference for a measurement. The posterior strategy derives Point O using full-arch geometry and maps it into the local frame.
concept.annotation: The posterior branch requires teeth_instance and raises ValueError when it is absent.
concept.code-link: Maps reference coordinates through cropping and orientation handling.

concept.name: Length result
concept.description: Physical path length and, when populated by the posterior branch, reference distance and combined working length, in millimeters.
concept.annotation: centerline_length_mm converts voxel differences using spacing in Z,Y,X order before summing segment lengths.
When the posterior branch completes, working_length_mm is length_b_mm plus length_mm.
concept.code-link: Converts a voxel path to physical length.

context.name: Measurement presentation
context.description: Turn the computed results into table rows and geometry a researcher can inspect.

concept.name: Displayed path
concept.description: Points restored for drawing. The app may prepend Point O to a new array so the visual path includes the reference segment.
concept.code-link: Restores local coordinates and constructs the line annotation.

relationship.name: selects
relationship.description: The FDI selection isolates the matching tooth and pulp masks.
relationship.code-link: Selects both masks with the same label.

relationship.name: supplies
relationship.description: Cropping, orientation handling, extraction, and calculation produce canal results.

relationship.name: identifies locally
relationship.description: The canal index identifies one result within its returned list. Persistent identity across recalculation remains a separate modeling decision.
relationship.code-link: Enumerates recovered apices and assigns tooth_id.

relationship.name: contains
relationship.description: The proposed aggregate gathers the measured path with its endpoints and region.

relationship.name: contains
relationship.description: Reference geometry participates in the consistency of the measurement.

relationship.name: contains
relationship.description: Derived values depend on the same geometry and spacing.

relationship.name: becomes
relationship.description: Why does the drawn path differ from the path being measured? Presentation restores coordinates and may prepend Point O to a new display array. The measured path remains the input for the tabulated length and angle.
relationship.annotation: The app extends display_centerline when point_O exists. The single-canal calculation branch separately extends canal.centerline with a crown reference. These are distinct operations with distinct branch conditions.
relationship.code-link: Compare centerline, display_centerline, and the Point O branch.
The single-canal branch modifies the calculation path itself.

relationship.name: supplies selected tooth to
relationship.description: Selection and measurement use the FDI label for different responsibilities: isolating masks and selecting calculation behavior.

relationship.name: supplies results to
relationship.description: The app reads measurement objects and builds table rows and spatial annotations.
relationship.code-link: Builds the researcher-facing result from the computed canals.
